name: Next Match
author: Talal A. Alsubaie
description: Your team's next fixture in the bar, both crests and a countdown, with live scores while it plays.

barWidget.description: Your team's next fixture in the bar, both crests and a countdown, with live scores while it plays.

schema.label: Team
schema.description: TheSportsDB's numeric team id. You should not have to type this: click the widget and search for your club by name, or by league name to browse it.

schema.label: Show the club crest
schema.description: Puts the opponent's crest in the bar in place of the icon. Off falls back to the icon, as it does anyway while a crest is still loading or missing.

schema.label: Show the score while the match is on
schema.description: The pill becomes a live scoreline once the match kicks off. Off leaves it on the kick-off label, which is the setting to pick if you would rather not know before you watch it back.

schema.label: Base refresh
schema.description: Minutes between checks when the next match is more than a day away. Only a floor: the widget already slows to 6 hours when nothing is close and tightens to 5 minutes during a match.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Glyph shown when there is no crest to show. Any emoji or Nerd Font glyph.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is scheduled
schema.description: Off-season and international breaks leave no fixture to show. On, the widget takes no space at all until one appears.
